# algolia_personalization_strategy (Resource)

Manages the Algolia app-level Personalization strategy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "algolia" {
  analytics_region = "us"
}

resource "algolia_personalization_strategy" "example" {
  personalization_impact = 80

  events_scoring {
    event_name = "Product Clicked"
    event_type = "click"
    score      = 50
  }

  facets_scoring {
    facet_name = "category"
    score      = 30
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `personalization_impact` (Number) Impact of personalization on search results.

### Optional

- `events_scoring` (Block List) Scoring rules for tracked events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--events_scoring))
- `facets_scoring` (Block List) Scoring rules for facet attributes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--facets_scoring))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for the singleton personalization strategy resource.

<a id="nestedblock--events_scoring"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events_scoring`

Required:

- `event_name` (String)
- `event_type` (String)
- `score` (Number)


<a id="nestedblock--facets_scoring"></a>
### Nested Schema for `facets_scoring`

Required:

- `facet_name` (String)
- `score` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The personalization strategy is a singleton per application. Import it with
# the literal ID "default".
terraform import algolia_personalization_strategy.example default
```
